svg.text: Nominal distances from the v9 design assumptions. These circles are not obstruction-corrected or guaranteed coverage.
RF / Remote ID · ~400 m per site
EO/IR camera nominal reach · day and night
Maroon rings: six nominal RF / Remote ID reception areas.
Radio-silent targets remain dependent on radar/camera observations.
Direction-finding accuracy and reception depend on geometry and noise.
Teal: garage day (~2 km). Blue: edge day (~1 km).
Maroon: edge night (~400 m); garage night range not specified.
Each PTZ camera observes one assigned target at a time in the demo.
Circles show planning reach only. Building blockage, weather, target size, resolution, interference and camera scheduling reduce practical coverage.
